answer_2.quote: We also calculate the F0 Frame Error (FFE) for objective evaluation... we calculate the Fréchet Audio Distance (FAD), Kullback-Leibler Divergence (KLD), and the CLAP score (CLAP).

answer_4.quote: We conduct both subjective and objective evaluations on generated samples. Regarding the evaluation of SVS synthesis, we conduct a crowd-sourced human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk... For the evaluation of accompaniment synthesis, we asked the raters to evaluate the audio samples in terms of overall quality (OVL), relevance to the prompt (REL), and alignment with the melody (MEL).
answer_4.guideline: Raters score samples on a 1-5 Likert scale for MOS and SMOS, and answer specific questions on overall quality (OVL), relevance to the text prompt (REL), and melody alignment (MEL).
